# Akamai
> Akamai provides cloud computing, security, and content delivery services, with documentation for APIs, products, developer tools, and operational guidance.

Akamai’s developer and product resources span platform APIs, edge computing, application security, delivery optimization, DNS, storage, and account management. The most useful LLM-oriented entry points are the developer portal, product documentation, API references, CLI and SDK resources, and learning materials.

## Developer Portal
- [Akamai Developer](https://developer.akamai.com/): Main developer portal for Akamai APIs, tools, guides, and platform resources.
- [Documentation Home](https://techdocs.akamai.com/): Central documentation hub for Akamai products, services, and workflows.
- [API Reference](https://techdocs.akamai.com/home/page/api): Entry point for Akamai API reference documentation across products.
- [Open APIs](https://developer.akamai.com/api): Browse Akamai APIs for configuration, security, delivery, and account automation.
- [Developer Blog](https://developer.akamai.com/blog): Articles, announcements, tutorials, and product updates for developers.
- [Learning](https://learn.akamai.com/): Training and learning resources for Akamai products and platform capabilities.

## Core Platform and Account Management
- [Akamai Control Center APIs](https://techdocs.akamai.com/home/page/control-center-apis): APIs for account, identity, and platform management tasks.
- [Identity and Access Management](https://techdocs.akamai.com/iam/docs): Manage users, roles, API clients, and access controls.
- [API Client Authentication](https://techdocs.akamai.com/developer/docs/set-up-authentication-credentials): Set up EdgeGrid authentication credentials for Akamai APIs.
- [Akamai CLI](https://github.com/akamai/cli): Command-line interface for Akamai APIs and operational workflows.
- [CLI Package Manager](https://github.com/akamai/cli-manager): Install and manage Akamai CLI packages and extensions.
- [Terraform Provider](https://techdocs.akamai.com/terraform/docs): Infrastructure as code support for managing Akamai resources.

## Delivery and Edge Configuration
- [Property Manager](https://techdocs.akamai.com/property-mgr/docs): Configure CDN delivery behavior, origins, caching, and edge logic.
- [Application Load Balancer](https://techdocs.akamai.com/application-load-balancer/docs): Manage traffic steering and load balancing across origins.
- [Cloud Wrapper](https://techdocs.akamai.com/cloud-wrapper/docs): Provision and manage cloud-based delivery configurations.
- [Edge DNS](https://techdocs.akamai.com/edge-dns/docs): Authoritative DNS configuration, zones, records, and traffic management.
- [Global Traffic Management](https://techdocs.akamai.com/gtm/docs): Direct users to optimal endpoints based on health and geography.
- [Image and Video Manager](https://techdocs.akamai.com/image-and-video-manager/docs): Optimize media delivery with transformation and performance controls.

## Security and Zero Trust
- [App and API Protector](https://techdocs.akamai.com/app-api-protector/docs): Protect web applications and APIs with WAF and security controls.
- [Bot Manager](https://techdocs.akamai.com/bot-manager/docs): Detect and mitigate automated abuse and malicious bots.
- [API Security](https://techdocs.akamai.com/api-security/docs): Discover, monitor, and protect API endpoints and traffic.
- [Prolexic](https://techdocs.akamai.com/prolexic/docs): DDoS protection and mitigation for network and application attacks.
- [Guardicore Segmentation](https://techdocs.akamai.com/guardicore-segmentation/docs): Microsegmentation and east-west traffic security for workloads.
- [Enterprise Application Access](https://techdocs.akamai.com/eaa/docs): Zero trust access to private applications without traditional VPNs.
- [Secure Internet Access Enterprise](https://techdocs.akamai.com/siae/docs): Secure web gateway and cloud-delivered internet access protection.

## Edge Compute and Serverless
- [EdgeWorkers](https://techdocs.akamai.com/edgeworkers/docs): Run JavaScript at the edge for request handling and personalization.
- [EdgeKV](https://techdocs.akamai.com/edgekv/docs): Low-latency key-value storage for edge applications.
- [Cloudlets](https://techdocs.akamai.com/cloudlets/docs): Apply edge logic for routing, redirects, and request control.
- [Functions](https://techdocs.akamai.com/functions/docs): Serverless compute for event-driven workloads on Akamai cloud infrastructure.
- [Containers](https://techdocs.akamai.com/containers/docs): Run and manage containerized workloads on Akamai cloud services.
- [Linode API](https://techdocs.akamai.com/linode-api/docs): API documentation for Akamai cloud compute, networking, and storage resources.

## Storage, Media, and Data Services
- [NetStorage](https://techdocs.akamai.com/netstorage/docs): Store and deliver content using Akamai’s distributed storage platform.
- [Media Services Live](https://techdocs.akamai.com/msl/docs): Live video streaming workflows and media delivery configuration.
- [Media Services On Demand](https://techdocs.akamai.com/msod/docs): Video-on-demand packaging and streaming delivery workflows.
- [DataStream 2](https://techdocs.akamai.com/datastream2/docs): Export delivery and security logs to external destinations.
- [mPulse](https://techdocs.akamai.com/mpulse/docs): Real user monitoring and performance analytics for web applications.
- [Cloud Monitor](https://techdocs.akamai.com/cloud-monitor/docs): Monitoring and observability for Akamai cloud infrastructure resources.

## APIs, SDKs, and Automation
- [API Definitions](https://developer.akamai.com/api): Catalog of Akamai APIs and product-specific endpoints.
- [Akamai OPEN EdgeGrid for Go](https://github.com/akamai/AkamaiOPEN-edgegrid-golang): Go authentication library for calling Akamai APIs with EdgeGrid.
- [Akamai OPEN EdgeGrid for Java](https://github.com/akamai/AkamaiOPEN-edgegrid-java): Java authentication library for Akamai API integrations.
- [Akamai OPEN EdgeGrid for Python](https://github.com/akamai/AkamaiOPEN-edgegrid-python): Python authentication library for Akamai API integrations.
- [Akamai OPEN EdgeGrid for Node.js](https://github.com/akamai/AkamaiOPEN-edgegrid-node): Node.js authentication library for Akamai API integrations.
- [Akamai CLI GitHub Organization](https://github.com/akamai): Source repositories for Akamai developer tools, SDKs, and integrations.

## Guides and Tutorials
- [Get Started with Akamai APIs](https://techdocs.akamai.com/developer/docs): Introductory guidance for using Akamai developer tools and APIs.
- [Authentication and Authorization](https://techdocs.akamai.com/developer/docs/set-up-authentication-credentials): Configure credentials and authenticate requests to Akamai APIs.
- [Use Postman with Akamai APIs](https://techdocs.akamai.com/developer/docs/postman): Explore and test Akamai APIs with Postman collections.
- [CLI Documentation](https://techdocs.akamai.com/developer/docs/cli): Learn Akamai CLI installation, usage, and extension workflows.
- [Terraform Documentation](https://techdocs.akamai.com/terraform/docs): Manage Akamai resources declaratively with Terraform provider guidance.
- [Code Samples](https://github.com/akamai?q=&type=all&language=&sort=): Browse Akamai GitHub repositories for examples, tools, and automation.

## Product Documentation
- [Documentation Home](https://techdocs.akamai.com/): Browse all Akamai product and platform documentation.
- [What’s New](https://techdocs.akamai.com/home/page/release-notes): Release notes and recent changes across Akamai documentation and products.
- [TechDocs Home](https://techdocs.akamai.com/home/docs): Overview of documentation structure, navigation, and product areas.
- [Search Documentation](https://techdocs.akamai.com/search): Search across Akamai technical documentation and references.
- [System Status](https://status.akamai.com/): Operational status and incident information for Akamai services.
- [Community](https://community.akamai.com/): Community discussions, questions, and peer support for Akamai users.
